title.narrative: EU System for an Enabling Environment for Civil Society (EU SEE): Coordination, Monitor and Early Warning Mechanism

description.narrative: The global objective: Civil society partners at global, regional and partner country levels, capacity and ability to detect and respond to situations of a deteriorating or improving enabling environment, and address and contribute to structural prerequisites for such an environment, to be improved. Given it is a concept note stage, the proposed activities are framed at a higher level. TI’s main roles are supporting the monitoring with country-level data focusing on anti-corruption activists, capacity building on civil society participation in decision-making and whistleblowing, and sub-granting to national chapters. Key deliverables:-Setup and manage operative structure for EU SEE coordination (Secretariat, EU SEE Management Group, EU SEE Advocates Group)-Establishment and coordination of the EU SEE Network of in-country CSO (40% of the budget goes to these members)-Dialogue of EU SEE Network with EU Delegations-Capacity strengthening of EU SEE Network members (Digitalization and data technologies; an enabling legislative and administrative environment for civil society; access to policy dialogue; the promotion of a positive narrative on civil society and capacity to identify and address the root causes of shrinking civic space, public participation in decision-making) -Developing and implementing a methodology and instrument for systematic Early Warning; EU SEE Monitoring Index developed and implemented for EU SEE Countries-Digital knowledge and coordination hub-Dissemination and advocacy Total value of the contract is EUR 30,000,000, TI-S's budget is EUR 1, 500,000~. The project is funded by the Directorate General for International Partnerships (DG INTPA), European Commission and led by Hivos. Partners are - Civicus, European Partnership for Democracy (EPD), Forus International, Transparency International. Affiliated entities: Article19 and Democracy Reporting International (linked to EPD).

recipient-region.narrative: This project is managed by TI-S which is headquartered in Germany and is a global poject.
